listings.name: Rusty's Markets
listings.otherProducts: Flowers, delicatessen items including bread, dairy and seafood, and many non-food stalls.
listings.hoursAsStated: Friday-Saturday: 5am to 4pm. Sunday: 5am to 3pm.
listings.description: Long-running weekend market in the Cairns CBD with fruit, vegetable and flower stalls among about 180 stalls.
listings.caveats: Mixed market (produce plus fashion, crafts and food stalls). Postcode not on the pages opened. Third-party sites give different hours; the market's own site was used.

listings.name: Clifford's Honey Farm
listings.otherProducts: Honey ice-cream, honey mead and a honey wheat ale, dressings and chutneys, honey drinks and biscuits, candles, cosmetics, wax products, local arts and crafts; guided extracting-shed tours.
listings.hoursAsStated: Farm Gate Shop: Open 7 days, 9am to 5pm (Closed Christmas Day only).
listings.description: Kangaroo Island honey farm with a farm-gate shop selling its Ligurian honey and honey products.
listings.caveats: Postcode not on the page opened.

listings.name: Mount Claremont Farmers' Market
listings.otherProducts: Fresh produce from farm stalls, plus food, drink and bread stalls.
listings.hoursAsStated: Open every Saturday 7.30-11.30am. Christmas closure: closed 26 December, open 2 January 2027.
listings.description: Saturday farmers' market run by the Mount Claremont Primary School P&C Association, billed as fresh produce from paddock to plate.
listings.caveats: Home page banner says 7.30-11 am in one place and 7:30am-11:30am in another; 11:30 used. Specific products not itemised on the page opened.

listings.name: Mundaring Garden and Farmers Market
listings.address: 3060 Jacoby Street (Mundaring Community Sculpture Park Amphitheatre)

hours.note: Saturdays 8am to noon. Dates are confirmed only to 19 December 2026, so check before you go.

listings.hoursAsStated: Open every Saturday from 8-12.
listings.description: Weekly Saturday garden and farmers market near the Sculpture Park in Mundaring.
listings.caveats: Council event page lists dates only to 19 Dec 2026 and does not itemise produce. Postcode not on the event page. Website taken from the council listing; not opened.

listings.name: Stirling Farmers Market
listings.address: 25 Cedric Street (City of Stirling Administration Building)
listings.otherProducts: Only produce direct from the grower or maker, plus community stalls.
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Sunday rain or shine 7:30 - 11:30am.
listings.description: Sunday farmers market at the City of Stirling administration building run as a project of the Rotary Club of Karrinyup.
listings.caveats: Site footer is dated 2017 and no current dates or closures are shown, so hours are as stated but not independently confirmed as current.

listings.name: Victor Harbor Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Fresh seasonal produce, baked goods, coffee and live music.
listings.hoursAsStated: Open every Saturday 8.00am - 12.30pm rain, hail or shine.
listings.description: Weekly Saturday farmers market in the park across from the main shopping centre in central Victor Harbor.
listings.caveats: Page footer is dated 2015 but the home page carries current-week news (stall count and a 14 Nov 2026 AGM). Postcode not on page.

listings.name: Bungaree Station Store
listings.address: 431 Bungaree Road (12 km north of Clare)
listings.otherProducts: Quince paste from the station orchard, pasta and snack foods from a neighbouring property, local Clare Valley produce, coffee and cheeses; self-guided tours of the historic station.
listings.hoursAsStated: The Station Store is open daily between 10am and 4pm.
listings.description: Historic station farm shop selling Bungaree lamb, free-range chicken and honey from the property, plus Clare Valley produce.
listings.caveats: Page does not say whether lamb and chicken are always in stock.

listings.name: Stanthorpe Cheese
listings.otherProducts: Farmhouse cheeses, tasting room, picnic supplies and local produce such as chutneys, relishes, vinegars, juices and cheese pastes; Jersey Girl cafe.

hours.note: Cafe and cheese tastings open daily; times not published. Call before visiting.

listings.hoursAsStated: Jersey Girl Cafe open daily for cheese tastings (no times stated).
listings.description: Dairy-farm cheese shop, tasting room and cafe on the Granite Belt.
listings.caveats: Opening times not stated on the pages opened; call before visiting.

listings.name: Berry Sweet Farm Shop

hours.note: Closed public holidays and a Christmas break from 25 Dec 2026, reopening Monday 11 Jan 2027.

listings.hoursAsStated: The shop is open from 9am - 5pm, excluding public holidays (subject to change).
listings.description: Strawberry grower's farm shop in Bullsbrook north-east of Perth.
listings.caveats: Stock in the shop is not listed on the page opened; products inferred only from the site describing the farm's strawberries. Page says hours are subject to change.

listings.name: Mount Pleasant Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Fresh seasonal produce, baked goods, honey, olive oil, eggs, meat and seafood, plants, flowers, fruit products, cheese and milk, coffee.

hours.note: Held in the Show Hall and adjoining grassed areas.

listings.hoursAsStated: Open every Saturday - 8am until 12pm.
listings.description: Saturday farmers market at the Mount Pleasant Showgrounds in the Adelaide Hills.
listings.caveats: Street number and postcode not on the pages opened. Products come from the tourism page's general description, so they are not placed in the structured products list.

listings.name: Yandina Country Markets
listings.otherProducts: Fruit, vegetables, deli products and local meat.
listings.hoursAsStated: Open 6am-12pm every Saturday. Described as one of the largest produce markets on the coast with fruit, veg, deli products and local meat.
listings.description: Saturday morning produce market described by Visit Sunshine Coast as one of the largest on the coast.
listings.caveats: Only the Visit Sunshine Coast guide was opened (no market site opened), and it gives no street address.

listings.name: Kawana Waters Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Local fruit, vegetables and other produce.
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Saturday from 7am-12pm.
listings.description: Saturday morning farmers market in Kawana Waters.
listings.caveats: Only the Visit Sunshine Coast guide was opened (no market site opened), and it gives no street address.

listings.name: Marcoola Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Organic fruit and vegetables, meats and cheese.
listings.hoursAsStated: Saturday mornings from 8am-12pm; guide mentions organic fruit and veg, meats and cheese.
listings.description: Saturday morning farmers market at Berry Keeper in Marcoola.
listings.caveats: Only the Visit Sunshine Coast guide was opened (no market site opened), and it gives no street address. Guide places it at Berry Keeper, Marcoola.

listings.name: Maleny Cheese
listings.otherProducts: Own cheeses and yoghurt (cheddar, brie, fetta, buffalo cheeses; Greek-style yoghurt), cafe, tasting tours.
listings.hoursAsStated: Our shop is open Monday to Sunday from 10 am - 3 pm.
listings.description: Hinterland dairy processor with a retail shop and cafe beside its cheese factory and its own dairy farm.
listings.caveats: Resolves the first-pass lead (site now loads). Milk is sourced from five small hinterland dairy farms plus the family's own farm, so this is a processor shop rather than a pure farm gate. Postcode not on page.

listings.name: Palm Beach Farmers Market
listings.address: Palm Beach Currumbin High School, Thrower Drive
listings.otherProducts: Produce from local growers, olives, sourdough and bakery items, spice mixes, flowers, local honey, hot smoked salmon.
listings.hoursAsStated: Saturday, 6am - 11.30am.
listings.description: Saturday school-grounds farmers market on the southern Gold Coast.
listings.caveats: Source is the Experience Gold Coast tourism blog (dated 4 Aug 2026); no market site opened. Postcode not given.

listings.name: Burleigh Farmers Market
listings.address: Burleigh Heads State School, 1750 Gold Coast Highway
listings.otherProducts: Fresh fruit and in-season vegetables, preserves, local honey, flowers, plus food trucks and a barista.
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Saturday from 7am, rain, hail or shine (tourism blog); 7am to 12pm (Scout Magazine guide).
listings.description: Saturday beachside farmers market in the grounds of Burleigh Heads State School.
listings.caveats: The 12:00 end time comes from an older Scout Magazine guide; the tourism blog gives only the 7am start. No market site opened.

listings.name: Helensvale Farmers Market
listings.address: Helensvale State High School, 243 Discovery Drive
listings.otherProducts: Fresh fruit, vegetables, flowers, health food, plus breakfast and coffee.
listings.hoursAsStated: Saturday, 6am-11am.
listings.description: Saturday farmers market at Helensvale State High School on the northern Gold Coast.
listings.caveats: Source is the Experience Gold Coast tourism blog (4 Aug 2026); the market's own site returned a server block. Older guide gave 6am-11am too.

listings.name: Organic Gold Coast Farmers Market
listings.address: Merrimac State High School, Dunlop Court
listings.otherProducts: Meats, honey, preserves, artisan ingredients and natural health products.
listings.hoursAsStated: Sundays, 6am - 11am.
listings.description: Sunday market described as selling certified organically grown produce, held at Merrimac State High School.
listings.caveats: Organic claim is the tourism blog's wording (certified organically grown produce); no certifier named and no market site opened.

listings.name: HOTA Farmers and Artisan Markets
listings.otherProducts: Farm-fresh in-season produce, artisan foods, fashion and handcrafted wares.
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Sunday morning from 6am to 11.30am.
listings.description: Sunday farmers and artisan market in the HOTA arts precinct, coordinated by Goodwill Projects.
listings.caveats: HOTA's own event page still shows 2025 dates; the Experience Gold Coast blog (Aug 2026) confirms the Sunday 6am-11.30am schedule. Locality shown as on HOTA's page (Surfers Paradise); the blog says Bundall.

listings.name: Batchelor Markets
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Sunday between April to December from 8am to 1pm.
listings.description: Sunday community market under rain trees in Batchelor, near Litchfield National Park.
listings.caveats: Official NT tourism article only; no market site opened and produce focus is described only as local products and produce.
